findings.claim: The correction rewrapped the Activity 3 starter comments in PEP_PAGE and in the no-JavaScript <pre>, but the fieldset's data-static-alt reading text still carries the old line breaks, for example '// 2. Add an instance method isLong() that returns true // when pages is over 300.'. artifact.md copies that text into '### explore', so the companion keeps the pre-correction comment breaks. The words are the same and the text is flattened onto one line, so a reader loses nothing; it is a stale copy, not a teaching error.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate or edit data-static-alt so its starter matches the new comment breaks, then regenerate artifact.md.
